mapper.sql: training.training_num, training.training_id, training.activity_num, training.training_name, training.training_detail, training.training_begintime, training.training_endtime, training.training_location, training.training_checkin, activity.activity_name, (select count(*) from volunteer_training_situation where volunteer_training_situation.training_num = training.training_num and volunteer_training_situation.vtsituation_isdeleted = 0) as situation_count
mapper.select:
select
from training, activity where training.activity_num = activity.activity_num and training.training_isdeleted = 0 and activity.activity_isdeleted = 0 and exists (select 1 from participate where participate.activity_num = training.activity_num and participate.volunteer_num = #{volunteerNum,jdbcType=INTEGER} and participate.participate_applystate = '1' and participate.participate_isdeleted = 0) order by training.training_begintime desc, training.training_num desc
select coalesce(max(cast(substring(training_id, 5) as unsigned)), 0) + 1 from training where training_id like 'tra%' and char_length(training_id) = 9
